text: # For sex and age, final results used from Newspoll survey conducted 28 June - 1 July 2016
Question: If a federal election for the House of Representatives was held today, which one of the
following would you vote for? If "uncommitted", to which one of these do you have a leaning?
Preference flows based on recent federal and state elections
These surveys were conducted among voters in all states of Australia and in both city and country
areas. The data has been weighted to reflect the population distribution. This latest survey is
based on a reanalysis of surveys conducted between 24 January and 10 March 2019 and is based
on a total of 6,393 interviews among voters. Individual state sample bases range from 562 to 2,032
voters. Note: sample size in Tasmania is too small for a meaningful separate analysis, however
Tasmania is included in total figures. Sampling error ranges from plus or minus 1.2 percentage
points on the total sample to plus or minus 4.l percentage points for the state with the smallest
sample size. Copyright at all times remains with Newspoll.
